prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision in which our client was injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Should your insured or any representative of your company need to speak with our client, we ask that you first obtain our consent.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, and provide a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the adjuster handling the file.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or telematics footage, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or other parties. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
